questions.question: How will a king reign, according to Isaiah 32?
options: In great wealth, and all the nations will serve him
In righteousness, and princes will rule in justice
In fear, and the people will tremble before him
In strength, and his armies will never fail
questions.answer: In righteousness, and princes will rule in justice

questions.question: What happens when the Spirit is poured out from on high in Isaiah 32?
options: The bright sun is darkened and all of the stars fall from the sky
All of the nations gather themselves together to wage war on Zion
The high mountains shake and tremble and all the valleys are filled
The wilderness becomes a fruitful field and justice and peace dwell
questions.answer: The wilderness becomes a fruitful field and justice and peace dwell

questions.question: Isaiah 32 says the effect of righteousness will be peace, and quietness and trust forever.
Behold, a king will reign in _____, and princes will rule in justice.
The effect of righteousness will be _____, and the result of righteousness, quietness and trust forever.
